title.zh: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K
title.en: ‘Leave’: Crypto Backlash Over French Proposal to Report Wallets Over $112K

current_state.zh: French lawmakers advanced a proposal requiring crypto holders to declare holdings of €100,000 or more under penalty of fines up to €10,000, prompting industry backlash over privacy and personal-security risks amid a wave of physical crypto robberies in France.
